question: On fresh narrative-tense prompts, does the token-identical source region carry the donor-directed L11H3 effect through exact effective values after the head output projection?

prior_result.reason: The frozen native reinstall tolerance and an algebraically unsuitable partial-versus-whole control bound failed. It remains invalid; its strong R-joint movement is only an outcome-selected hypothesis for this fresh test.

novelty_search.finding: No fresh-vocabulary, token-identical-carrier, exact effective-value screen for narrative-tense L11H3 was found.

fresh_authority.label: fresh_confirmation
fresh_authority.source: Flatten pronoun-authority objects and locations, remove every old narrative-tense word, preserve first occurrence, and require one GPT-2 token with a leading space.
fresh_authority.vocabulary_overlap_limit: The 82 words cannot form three disjoint 32-word role sets. Alternate-subject and tail vocabularies overlap; require a unique subject/alternate/tail within each row and 32 unique tuples, not disjoint role vocabularies.

templates.A1: Yesterday/Today the SUBJECT remained/remains indoors. The central purpose of the TAIL -> was/is
templates.A2: The SUBJECT that remained/remains indoors yesterday/today drew/draws notice. The central purpose of the TAIL -> was/is
templates.P: Same A1 tense and answer; only the subject changes between two fresh alternate nouns not used by that group's A1/A2 endpoint.
templates.C: Same past answer; subject and earlier location change. C tests only past-tense selectivity.

fresh_authority.role_algorithm: X is the exact set of changed token positions and self is the final input. R contains every non-self position with identical token IDs. Complement is X union self. Fixed causal-time subgroups are pre_first_change, between_changes, and post_last_change, excluding X.

definitions.score: donor attention probability times recipient effective value
definitions.effective_value: recipient native attention probability times donor u, where u includes the head output projection
definitions.joint: donor attention probability times donor effective value
definitions.same_batch_control: expanded_native is untouched while native_reinstall receives the saved native head in the same expanded call

registered_outcomes.pred_a_instrument_live: Exactness, capability, and complete-H3 gates pass; selectivity is conditional, not instrument validity.
registered_outcomes.pred_b_unchanged_carrier_route: R-joint passes recovery, direction, complement advantage, liveness, and direct P/C selectivity.
registered_outcomes.pred_c_unchanged_carrier_effective_value: R effective value passes recovery, direction, liveness, and P/C selectivity after pred_b.
registered_outcomes.pred_d_pre_first_negative_control: Pre-first effective-value installation is algebraically zero where prefixes match; any nonzero change invalidates exactness.
registered_outcomes.pred_e_between_changes_effective_value: The fixed between-cues effective-value subgroup is sufficient and selective.
registered_outcomes.pred_f_post_last_change_effective_value: The fixed post-last-cue effective-value subgroup is sufficient and selective.
registered_outcomes.pred_g_distributed_R_effective_value: R effective value passes, but neither causal subgroup is sufficient alone.
registered_outcomes.pred_h_no_unchanged_carrier_route: The instrument is live but R-joint fails its causal or selectivity gates.

reported_interactions: complete_head - R_joint - complement_joint + expanded_native, for margin and CE
R_joint - R_score - R_effective_value + expanded_native, for margin and CE
interpretation_limits: u is after the output projection; this does not separately identify the cached pre-projection value.
Large interaction contrasts forbid additive allocation language.
A control cell with a numerically dead installed carrier change is uninformative, not selective.
